nodes.title: Why the agent lane reads probed skills right less often than the Director (4A root cause of ms-r143-decided-gate-director-vs-agent; sim lab run r5-rel143-9a30285-decided-gate, claude/r5-simlab 551f72dd, 64 cards x 2 arms, text, decided child). The misreads are UNDER-reads, not over-claims. Agent 117/182 agree, 42 under, 23 over; Director 120/163, 21 under, 22 over. The agent's excess is understood->partly: 38 vs 11. Maths carries it: 23 under vs 7. The judge mirrors the agent's own end check on 34 of those 38 (23 'partly: some right, not steady yet', 11 'practised: not yet checked with a why'), so the cause is the agent's read, fed by its grades. The evidence read was replayed on the truth=understood skills (n=73) using the grades the server actually gave; 20 read understood. Of the 53 that did not: 18 had no right deep answer at all (probe coverage); 15 had a right deep answer lost to no_evidence (grading); 6 had no answer for the skill; 6 had a miss or partly in the record (a slip, or learned mid-lesson); 5 had a deep answer graded right and still sat under the 0.8 bar (the read rule). Grading, both arms: of the agent's right answers to a posed card, 127 came back no_evidence, about 38% (Director 56, a similar rate on 233 card turns vs the agent's 774). Of the 127, 107 were graded against the card the child answered. Re-classified offline on the current code (answer head and Devanagari fractions in), 98 of the 107 are still no_evidence, nearly all a model 'correct' vetoed by corroboration: foreign_number 24, low_cover 24, negated 12, number_hedge 8, unreadable_number 8, missing_number 7, swapped_word 7, number_order 4, missing_decisive 2. 46 of the 107 carried a reason ('kyunki ...'), the shape the agent invites by asking why. With every decided answer graded perfectly, the same read agrees 110/168 with 47 under: grading costs about 26 agreements, and the read rule (bar 0.8, the deep requirement, 2-3 answers per skill in 14 turns) is the second limit. Not covered by 14.4: the answer head rescues only foreign / extra / unreadable_number without an explanation, the deep marks (switch off) would make more skills plain-only, and the clauseGate / affirm work does not touch reads.

The reason head (14.5 (a), main's conditions; grading/corroborate.js reasonHead + the number path in director/classify.js). A right answer said first, then its own reason, is credited when the text before the first reason marker (kyunki / kyuki / kyonki / because / taaki / isliye / so / क्योंकि / ताकि / इसलिए) carries a complete form on its own and the reason does not take it back. Vetoes: a correction; an alternative or hedge ('ya 8 lakh', 'par shayad X hoga'); don't-know; another value after an answer cue ('toh answer 8 lakh hai', '… toh 8 lakh hoga'); a negated head ('225 nahi'). A misconception read in the reason stays on the result; why and teach-back items are excluded. The 14.4 answer head now carries the same vetoes: before this it credited 68 constructed contradictions with the model forced to 'correct'. (1) Rescues of right answers that earned no evidence against the card the child answered (sim lab r5-rel143-9a30285-decided-gate, re-classified offline on the final code): agent 9 of 107 (5 number path, 4 corroboration), Director 3 of 41. Most of the rest have no listed marker (66 of 98 agent): 'matlab', a reason first, or no reason. Adding matlab / jaise / yaani as markers would rescue 1 more per arm. (2) False credit by the head rules on forms constructed from the same 112 items: 0 of 1,020 wrong-head + reason and 0 of 667 right-head + contradicting reason with the model forced to 'correct'; 0 of 340 and 0 of 223 with the real model. (3) Moved over 2,765 sim-lab child lines (r5-rel143 runs), worst case model 'correct': 17 of 1,191 (line, graded card) pairs, all no_evidence -> correct, listed in the commit's report to main.

Existing gap, found by the 14.5 constructed set: corroborate's whole-reply check ('supported') has no correction / alternative / other-answer veto. With the real model it credited 84 of 223 right-head + contradicting-reason forms ('5 and 5 make a ten, kyunki …, toh answer 70 hai'; 'oran ya The Bishnoi community …') and 4 of 340 wrong-head forms whose reason contained the key ('Sphere, isliye cuboid'). number_working credited 3 more. Same on the code before 14.5. Proposed: apply the reason-head vetoes to the whole-reply credit; measure rescue loss on real lines first.
'तेरा' for 13 (also 'your') is not read as a number: 1 right answer on the 14.3 decided gate earned no evidence (p03 #13). Out of scope for the reason head (main); needs a context rule if it recurs.
